## vMLX 1.6.21 for macOS

This Electron/Python checkpoint is built from source commit `498b357bf`.

### Highlights

- Streams that stop at `max_tokens` report their token usage again. Previously a reasoning turn cut short by the token cap emitted no terminal usage chunk, so OpenAI-compatible clients requesting `stream_options.include_usage` received nothing and the Anthropic route reported zero tokens with no cache-read accounting on an almost fully cached prompt.
- DeepSeek V4 Flash delta-cache restore reads its block size and anchor interval from the cache records instead of assuming fixed values.
- Built-in tools name an unusable working directory and the setting that fixes it rather than surfacing a raw filesystem error per call.
- Reasoning-rail DSML tool calls are recovered from their markup span, and prompt tool catalogs stay turn-independent so agentic loops keep reusing their cached prefix.
- The bundled runtime uses JANG 2.5.39.

Separate signed and Apple-notarized Apple-silicon downloads are available for macOS Tahoe and Sequoia-compatible systems. Tahoe is the default download. This focused checkpoint does not imply exhaustive certification of every model family or maximum-context configuration.
